children: Austin, Texas, United States, November 19th, 2026, FinanceWire
Safe Pro Group reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $2,676,680, which is a 2,539% increase year-over-year and up over 100% sequentially compared to Q2 2026.
The company also reported a record 79% AI gross margin, with a major decrease in operating expenses, and a strong balance sheet.
Revenue increase was primarily driven by U.S. Army and other U.S. government-contracted sales.
